cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(kami4_hair_solver VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES C CXX CUDA)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES 120)
set(CMAKE_CUDA_RUNTIME_LIBRARY Static)
set(CMAKE_CXX_CL_SHOWINCLUDES_PREFIX "Note: including file: ")
find_package(CUDAToolkit REQUIRED)
add_library(kami4_hair_core SHARED native/core.cu)
target_include_directories(kami4_hair_core PUBLIC native)
target_compile_definitions(kami4_hair_core PRIVATE K4_BUILD_DLL=1)
target_compile_options(kami4_hair_core PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CUDA>:--expt-relaxed-constexpr;--fmad=false;-lineinfo;-Xcompiler=/utf-8>)
install(TARGETS kami4_hair_core RUNTIME DESTINATION bin)
enable_testing()
add_executable(kami4_c_api_test tests/c_api_test.c)
target_link_libraries(kami4_c_api_test PRIVATE kami4_hair_core)
target_compile_features(kami4_c_api_test PRIVATE c_std_11)
target_compile_options(kami4_c_api_test PRIVATE /UNDEBUG)
add_test(NAME c_abi COMMAND kami4_c_api_test)
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)
if(Python3_FOUND)
  add_test(NAME independent_oracle COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/test_oracle.py")
  set_tests_properties(independent_oracle PROPERTIES ENVIRONMENT "PYTHONUTF8=1")
endif()
